title: Size charts
intro: Sizes (M, L, XL) come from ERP; measurements live here.

steps.one: One chart per product type & fit
steps.oneText: e.g. Polo · Regular fit. Every polo in that fit shares it.
steps.two: Set a default for a category
steps.twoText: New products in that category get it automatically — nothing to do.
steps.threeText: Copy the chart and change only what differs.

noCharts: No size charts yet. Make the first one with “New chart”.
name: Chart name
inchOnly: Type inches only — cm is worked out automatically
easeHelp: How much room the garment has over the body. Find my size uses this to pick the size.
howToSub: · shown to customers under the size chart
allCovered: All sizes covered — every ERP size of the {n} products using this chart has measurements.
allCoveredOne: All sizes covered — every ERP size of the product using this chart has measurements.
coverageHint: If ERP adds a new size (say 3XL) to one of them, a warning with an “Add row” button shows up here.
missingOne: {name} has {size} in ERP — add a row
missingMany: {name} and {more} more have {size} in ERP — add a row
copy: Copy for a style that fits differently
archiveConfirm: Archive “{name}”? It is kept, not deleted, and can be brought back.
productsSub: · the size chart each one shows
noProducts: No products use this chart yet.
defaultsSub: · new products there get this chart for its fit
addSub: Pick category and fit — the size chart is chosen for you.
changeSub: Use a different chart for this product:
pasteIntro: Copy the rows from Excel or Google Sheets and paste them here. One size per line — the size first, then the numbers in this order:
pasteExample: Example: S 38 27 16.5 7.5 · tabs, spaces or commas all work · a header line is skipped.
pasteNone: No rows found — each line needs a size and {n} numbers
pasteUnknown: Not one of the shop's sizes, left out: {sizes}
copyTitle: Copy for a style that fits differently
copyIntro: A new chart with the same measurements. Change only what differs, then set it where it belongs.
newRows: Measurements — one size per line: the size first, then {fields}

toast.pasted: {n} rows pasted — check them, then Save
toast.copied: Copy made — change only what differs
toast.needOneRow: A chart needs at least one size
toast.fillAll: Some boxes are empty or zero — please fill every measurement
